rules: Freeze the workload, hardware, noise floor and measurement settings before recording Rust candidates.
Retain all reports, source and fixture hashes, failing outcomes and unchanged thresholds.
These investment targets are local opt-in measurements, not ordinary CI timing gates.
Do not substitute V8 heap for whole-process RSS or compare Rust pure calls against Node HTTP/process latency.
No model downloads, real evaluator calls or live Claude requests are part of the deterministic driver.
Model inference time and completed-task quality remain separate from local gateway overhead.

measurement_settings.power_and_load_conditions: Record observed power source, low-power settings and load before/after each round. Uncontrolled developer-host runs are exploratory, cannot approve representative-hardware gate.
measurement_settings.null_means: Not yet measured or ratified; a comparison must refuse to claim acceptance until specified.
measurement_settings.http_percentiles: nearest rank independently per round; 2000 observations include 20 observations in upper one percent
measurement_settings.uncertainty: 5000 deterministic paired bootstrap resamples over five matched rounds; report 95% interval of median paired metric difference or ratio; no removal of outliers
measurement_settings.note: Frozen before first Rust implementation timing on 2026-10-09; changes require a new protocol version and new Node baseline.

real_evaluator_policy.inherited_failures: Existing experimental Ollama absolute quality failures remain failed and visible; matching them does not require relabeling fixtures or changing the model/rubric to complete the language port.
real_evaluator_policy.candidate_gate: No unexplained regression under a comparison policy declared before matched real runs. No current-provider claim follows from synthetic parity.
